name: coverage_check
description: Find important entities an existing AI research result may have missed and report observable search saturation and known gaps.
use_when: comprehensive company or market discovery matters
competitor or supplier mapping should minimize omissions
an agent needs to decide whether further web research is worthwhile
do_not_use_when: only a few examples are requested
the task is a simple factual lookup

body_example.task: Find US pet-tech companies making connected consumer hardware

limitations: No mathematical completeness claim for the open web
Coverage depends on accessible public sources
